fusions.name: The Weak Seam Seen
fusions.desc: A sting that deals 28 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Sweeping Gaze
fusions.desc: Fires stingers through a cone 4 tiles long. The cone deals 3 damage to everything in it, with a 35% chance to leave each target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Compound Sight
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Face Remembered
fusions.desc: Every hit you land on an enemy builds a stack on it, up to 5. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
